fns.desc: ssdp_listener_start() assigns sm->ssdp_sd = ssdp_listener_open() and never checks for -1 before calling eloop_register_sock(sm->ssdp_sd, ...); eloop_register_sock() does assert(sock >= 0), so a socket()/bind()/setsockopt() failure inside ssdp_listener_open() (e.g. fd exhaustion, port in use, permission denied) reaches a reachable assertion failure (abort/DoS) instead of the intended goto-fail cleanup path.
